title: French private equity firm Ardian partners with data center group Verne to build an up to €5B AI "gigafactory" outside Paris, targeting 500MW in total capacity (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: French private equity firm Ardian partners with data center group Verne to build an up to €5B AI “gigafactory” outside Paris, targeting 500MW in total capacity — Data centre and research facility to be built as Europe seeks to create ‘digital backbone for the future’
contentText:
Financial Times :

French private equity firm Ardian partners with data center group Verne to build an up to €5B AI “gigafactory” outside Paris, targeting 500MW in total capacity   —  Data centre and research facility to be built as Europe seeks to create ‘digital backbone for the future’
